# firebase_core

**Tag**: firebase, core, mobile

## 简介

Flutter plugin for Firebase Core, enabling connecting to multiple Firebase apps.

## 官网

- 主页: https://firebase.google.com/docs/flutter/setup
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/firebase/flutterfire/tree/main/packages/firebase_core/firebase_core
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_core
